title: Referral: 58-year-old man with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes

payload.case_notes: Patient: Mr John Carter, 58 M. Visits: 12/09/2026 polyuria, fatigue; HbA1c 8.9%; BMI 31. 26/09/2026 commenced metformin 500 mg bd; BP 148/92; lipids: LDL 3.9. Social: smoker 10/day, sedentary. Plan: refer to diabetes educator for lifestyle program and glucose monitoring education.
payload.task_instruction: Using the information in the case notes, write a letter of referral to the diabetes educator. Expand the relevant notes into complete sentences. Do not use note form. The body of the letter should be approximately 180-200 words.
payload.recipient: Ms Priya Nair, Diabetes Educator, Community Health Centre, 14 Elm Street, Riverside
key_content_points: Reason for referral: education and lifestyle program
Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes with HbA1c 8.9%
Current medication metformin 500 mg twice daily
Cardiovascular risk factors: BP, LDL, smoking, BMI
